name: NearFear
description: Detect and manage nearby phobias with sensor data and community input.

screens.name: MapScreen
screens.purpose: Display nearby phobias on a map.

features.name: map-display
features.description: Shows phobia locations using MapView with markers.

features.name: location-tracking
features.description: Tracks user location to display nearby fears.

screens.layout: Full-screen map with markers and callouts.

screens.name: FearListScreen

features.name: fear-list
features.description: Displays a scrollable list of phobias.

features.name: add-fear
features.description: Allows users to add new phobias to the list.

features.name: delete-fear
features.description: Allows users to delete phobias from the list.

screens.layout: List of cards with fear details and actions.

features.name: settings
features.description: Allows users to adjust app settings.

features.name: logout
features.description: Allows users to log out of the application.

screens.name: FearDetailScreen
screens.purpose: Show detailed information about a specific phobia.

features.name: detail-view
features.description: Displays detailed information about a phobia.

features.name: sensor-data
features.description: Shows sensor data related to the phobia.

features.name: edit-fear
features.description: Allows users to edit the phobia details.

screens.layout: Detailed view with fear information and sensor data.

screens.name: AddFearScreen

features.name: form-input
features.description: Allows users to input phobia details.

features.name: location-picker
features.description: Allows users to select a location for the phobia.

features.name: sensor-capture
features.description: Captures sensor data related to the phobia.

screens.layout: Form for inputting phobia details and location.
